Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at: 5:00 PM, 03 July 2025(Thursday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Zambales, Bataan, Pampanga, Bulacan and Metro Manila.
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, expect light to moderate rains over Cavite, Batangas, Laguna, Rizal, Quezon, Tarlac and Nueva Ecija within the next 3 hours.
